API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APICloud & Branch Connector GroupsGet Ec VM By Instance Id
Get Ec VM By Instance Id
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecVm/uuid/:vmInstanceId

Retrieves details about a VM based on the provided Cloud or Branch Connector native public cloud instance ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
vmInstanceId
string
REQUIRED

The ID of the VM native public cloud instance.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

The ID of the VM.

name
string

The name of the VM.

status
string[]

The status of the VM.

Possible values: [DISABLED, REGISTERED, RESERVED1, PKG_REPO_REGISTERED, ENABLING, DISABLING, DELETING, DELETING_LAST, DELETED]

autoScale
boolean

Indicates whether auto scaling is enabled for the VM.

buildVersion
string

The build version of the VM.

ccRoleName
string

The Cloud Connector provisioning role name assigned to the VM.

failOpen
boolean

Indicates whether automatic failover is enabled.

formFactor
string

The form factor size of the VM. The supported values are SAMLL, MEDIUM, or LARGE.

Possible values: [SMALL, MEDIUM, LARGE]

managementNw
object
ecInstances
object[]
cityGeoId
int32

The city geographic ID where the VM is deployed.

deployAsGateway
boolean

Indicates whether the VM is deployed as a gateway.

dnsCache
boolean

Indicates whether auto populate DNS cache is enabled for the VM.

haStatus
string

Indicates the high availability (HA) status of the VM.

Possible values: [INIT, ACTIVE, STANDBY, DISABLED]

hardwareInfo
object
lanDns
object
lastTemplateConfigPushFailed
boolean

Indicates whether the last provisioning template configuration push failed.

lastUpgradeTime
int32

The date and time when the VM was last upgraded.

metaConfig
object
natIp
string

The NAT IP of the VM.

operationalStatus
string

Indicates the operational status of the VM.

pkgRepoSerialNumber
int32

The package repository certificate serial number of the VM.

provTemplate
object
provTemplateStatus
string

The deployment status of the provisioning template.

Possible values: [STAGED, NOT_DEPLOYED, DEPLOYED, EDITABLE]

trafficDistribution
string

The traffic distribution type across WANs.

Possible values: [BALANCED, BEST_LINK]

upgradeStatus
int32

The scheduled upgrade status of the VM.

upgradeStartTime
int32

The start time of the VM upgrade.

upgradeEndTime
int32

The end time of the VM upgrade.

upgradeDayOfWeek
int32

The scheduled upgrade day of the week. By default, this is Sunday.

useWanDns
boolean

Indicates whether WAN DNS is used for name resolution.

usedForZtp
boolean

Indicates whether the VM is used for Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP).

zeroTrustVm
boolean

Indicates whether the VM is configured as a Zero Trust Gateway.

ziaGateway
string

The ZIA gateway of the VM.

ziaGateways
string[]

The list of ZIA gateways of the VM.

zpaBroker
string

The ZPA broker of the VM.

zpaBrokers
string[]

The list of The ZPA brokers of the VM.
